features.quote: Max 20 turns or 32k total completion tokens, whichever is hit first.
features.justification_quote: Captures >90% of spirals; 20 turns is the sweet spot for cost vs. reproduction.

features.quote: If a session produces 3 consecutive turns with state_delta < 0.05 and self_criticism_density > 8, auto-terminate and flag as confirmed spiral.
features.justification_quote: Saves an average of 4–6 terminal turns.
